recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If resource diagrams are regenerated later, source/documentreference/documentreference.svg should pick up the corrected tooltip from the StructureDefinition, but no additional FHIR-41012 core source edit is needed.
issue_request: FHIR-41012 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for DocumentReference asking to change the misspelled short text from 'An explicitly assigned identifer' to 'An explicitly assigned identifier'.
initial_application: Commit 65ddda37df295aa1505355f0472bf39ca93a4101, 'close FHIR-41012 - spelling of identifier', explicitly changed source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml to use 'identifier'. The text had originally been introduced with the typo when DocumentReference.version was added in commit 5493ce6532e563d2c9cba54155c56a4edfa11ebc as part of the FHIR-38000 change family.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active in source/fhir.ini. The 2023-06-20 OO on FHIR minutes record FHIR-41012 as a technical correction to fix the typo. A 2025 Implementers Zulip thread about R5 DocumentReference.version confirms the typo was fixed in CI build while previous published revisions are not updated. FHIR-38000 is background for adding the element; FHIR-54506 is a later Submitted, unresolved Composition.version clarification issue and is not a final DocumentReference typo decision. The only remaining current source/documentreference occurrence of the reported misspelling is in source/documentreference/documentreference.svg, a checked-in generated-looking diagram tooltip.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source file was edited because the authoritative build-scope StructureDefinition source already contains the requested correction, and the workflow guardrails prohibit a source-changing reconciliation whose only edit is a generated-looking SVG artifact.
